title: Kibble-Zurek scaling and spatial statistics in quenched binary Bose superfluids
task: Characterize spatial organization of defects in binary Bose gas quenches
key_results: Domains and vortices obey Kibble-Zurek scaling; spatial distribution follows Poisson point process with KZ-determined density
comments: Extends KZ theory beyond density to reveal stochastic geometry of defects in multicomponent systems.

title: Population-scale characterization of the oral microbiome and associations with metabolic health

comments: Large-scale population study (n=9,431) with robust replication, though causality remains unestablished and oral-specific mechanisms linking microbial functions to systemic metabolism need mechanistic validation.
